body:
## Summary

In edit mode, clicking the anchor icon of a labelled table opens the "Rename label" popover. The icon of a table label sits in a zero-height row right above the table, and the popover opened 6 px under it, so it covered the header and the first row and swallowed clicks on those cells (a click on a covered cell hit the popover, so the cell editor never opened). This PR opens the popover above the icon when the labelled block starts right below it, so the table stays visible and clickable.

## Deliverables

The popover now opens above the icon in a 290 px pane (light and dark), instead of on top of the table.

| Before | After |
| --- | --- |
| ![before, light](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gsemet/markdown-okf-schema-studio/d4a9ba6698edff18035c36d77079923c9e6227cf/v46-before-light.png) | ![after, light](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gsemet/markdown-okf-schema-studio/d4a9ba6698edff18035c36d77079923c9e6227cf/v46-after-light.png) |
| ![before, dark](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gsemet/markdown-okf-schema-studio/d4a9ba6698edff18035c36d77079923c9e6227cf/v46-before-dark.png) | ![after, dark](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gsemet/markdown-okf-schema-studio/d4a9ba6698edff18035c36d77079923c9e6227cf/v46-after-dark.png) |

Placement rule, in short:

```ts
// src/page/modules/labelRename.ts (sketch)
if (anchor.closest(".okf-anchor-row")) {            // table, code block, figure, directive
  // scroll the page up by the missing height when the room above is short and the page can scroll
  if (room above >= popover height) { popover.bottom = icon.top - 6; side = "above"; return; }
}
popover.top = icon.bottom + 6; side = "below";     // paragraph or heading label, or no room
```

## Changes

- `labelRename.ts`: for an icon inside an anchor row, the popover is anchored by its bottom edge 6 px above the icon, so the status line grows upwards, away from the block. When the room between the icon and the top of the pane (the preview toolbar when it overlaps the popover horizontally, else 8 px from the viewport top) is short, the page scrolls up by the missing height first; at the very top of the document the popover stays below, as before.
- A label held by a paragraph or a heading keeps its placement under the icon. An outside press on a table cell still closes the popover and the cell editor opens in the same click.
- `contentBlockStyles.ts`: `box-sizing: border-box` on the popover so its width stays inside a narrow pane.
- Tests: unit tests of the placement, a real-input scenario (click a cell with the popover open), a visual scenario in a 290 px pane with a fixture, and the promoted QA replay. The requirement on the rename field (MYST-038) now states the placement.

## Impacts

Visible change in edit mode: the Rename label popover of a labelled table no longer covers the table. Screenshots before and after, light and dark, are in Deliverables above (pane 290 px, popover open). Labels held by a paragraph or a heading are unchanged.

| Before | After |
| --- | --- |
| ![before, light](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gsemet/markdown-okf-schema-studio/d4a9ba6698edff18035c36d77079923c9e6227cf/v46-before-light.png) | ![after, light](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gsemet/markdown-okf-schema-studio/d4a9ba6698edff18035c36d77079923c9e6227cf/v46-after-light.png) |
| ![before, dark](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gsemet/markdown-okf-schema-studio/d4a9ba6698edff18035c36d77079923c9e6227cf/v46-before-dark.png) | ![after, dark](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gsemet/markdown-okf-schema-studio/d4a9ba6698edff18035c36d77079923c9e6227cf/v46-after-dark.png) |

## Blast radius

Grade: 1. Placement of one popover; no write path changes. A plain `git revert` restores the previous placement.

## Test plan

- [x] New or changed tests (they fail on the previous code): placement unit tests, real-input and visual scenarios; on the previous code the visual check reports the field covering the cells and not above the icon.
- [x] Requirements: SwRS updated (MYST-038), markers in code and tests, `just requirements-update`
- [x] Local gates: `just check` green
- [ ] Review
- [ ] CI green (including the heavy run with the real VS Code window)

## Autonomous decisions

- Added `box-sizing: border-box` to the popover so that its width (22 em, capped to the pane) includes its padding and border and no longer overflows a 290 px pane.
- Raised the scenario count in the e2e groups test from 464 to 465 for the new visual scenario.
- The toolbar inset (the top obstruction) is read from the preview toolbar element in the page, not hard-coded, and only counts when the toolbar overlaps the popover horizontally: the toolbar floats at the top right, so in a wide pane a popover at the left may use the room beside it (found by the real-window test, where counting it made the popover fall back under the icon).
- The real-input scenario does not narrow the pane (the real window keeps its width); the narrow pane is covered by the visual scenario.
- The visual scenario has no machine checks of the covered paragraph, because the popover legitimately covers the end of the paragraph before the table.
- The popover carries a `data-okf-label-rename-side` attribute (`above` or `below`) so that tests and styles can tell where it opened.
- Screenshot "before" taken on a detached worktree of the base with the new visual scenario copied in.
